sentences.l2: 清晨六点，某大型综合医院的门诊大厅已是一片喧嚷。
sentences.l1: At six in the morning, the outpatient hall of a large general hospital is already a clamor.

sentences.l2: 自动挂号机前排起长队，人们攥着身份证与病历本，眼神里透着焦灼与期待。
sentences.l1: A long queue forms in front of the automatic registration machines, and people clutch their ID cards and medical record books, their eyes showing anxiety and expectation.

sentences.l2: 热门科室的专家号往往在放号后数分钟内被抢空，于是"号贩子"应运而生，将原本几十元的诊费炒至数百元，令不少外地患者望而却步。
sentences.l1: Specialist appointments in popular departments are often snapped up within minutes of release, so "ticket scalpers" have emerged to meet the need, hyping consultation fees that were originally a few dozen yuan to several hundred, discouraging many out-of-town patients.

sentences.l2: 取号之后，患者需先到分诊台报到，由护士依据病情的轻重缓急完成分诊，标注就诊优先级，再前往相应诊区候诊。
sentences.l1: After getting a number, patients must first report to the triage desk, where a nurse completes triage according to how severe and urgent the condition is, marks the priority for treatment, and then they go to the corresponding area to wait.

sentences.l2: 候诊区电子屏上的号码缓慢跳动，每一次跳号都牵动着数十双眼睛。
sentences.l1: The numbers on the electronic screen in the waiting area jump slowly, and every jump draws the attention of dozens of pairs of eyes.

sentences.l2: 有人反复刷新手机上的排队进度，有人则因空腹太久而面色苍白。
sentences.l1: Some people repeatedly refresh the queue progress on their phones, while others have pale faces from fasting too long.

sentences.l2: 对许多家庭而言，这样一次候诊不仅意味着半日的消磨，更折射出优质医疗资源分布不均的深层困境。
sentences.l1: For many families, such a wait not only means half a day spent, but also reflects the deep-seated predicament of the uneven distribution of high-quality medical resources.
